claims.claim: Neat refurbished standing Gas Cooker in perfect working condition.
claims.evidence: Photos show a 4-burner stainless/metal gas cooker with oven door open and visible racks, but no test results for ignition, heating, or gas-leak safety.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: No date/receipt/warranty details are shown in the provided photos.

claims.claim: No fault at all; the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show internal components or any functional test; 'motor' is not verifiable from the images.

risks.risk: Burners may not ignite reliably (or ignition system may be faulty), which affects usability and value.
risks.proof: One short video of each of the 4 burners lighting from cold (showing flame stability) and the oven burner igniting.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used gas cooker with unverified working ignition (assume needs inspection/possible repairs).

risks.risk: Oven may not heat evenly or may not reach temperature (control/thermostat or oven burner issue).
risks.proof: Clip showing oven ignition plus a temperature check (e.g., thermometer reading after a few minutes) and even heating (no hot/cold spots).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven for oven performance (assume average/unknown heating).

risks.risk: Gas-leak safety issues (leaks at valves/hoses/connection) are not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Video of a gas-leak test (soap-bubble test at all joints/valves) with no bubbles forming.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case safety risk level until leak test is shown.

risks.risk: Missing or worn parts (tray, rack condition, burner caps/spares) or damaged burner grates/caps can reduce completeness and cooking performance.
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing all included accessories laid out (tray, racks, burner caps/spares) and close-ups of each cap/grate for cracks/warping.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly incomplete/with wear (assume accessories may be missing or not perfect).

risks.risk: Physical damage not clearly visible (dents, cracks, warped door, damaged seals) could affect safety and heat retention.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of oven door seal area, hinges, and the full body for dents/cracks; plus a door-close test showing proper alignment.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with cosmetic wear and unknown structural condition.

risks.risk: Brand/model identification may be incomplete or incorrect; warranty claims may not match the unit.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating plate/serial/model number label on the cooker (front/back/side) and a matching warranty/receipt photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price without relying on brand/model/warranty credibility.

proof_requests: Video: light all 4 burners one by one from cold, showing stable flames.
Video: ignite the oven burner and show temperature rising (use a thermometer if possible).
Gas-leak test: soap-bubble test at all joints/valves with no bubbles.
Clear photos of the rating plate/serial/model number label.
Photos/clip of all accessories included (tray, racks, any spare caps) laid out and counted.
Close-ups of oven door seal/hinges and burner caps/grates for cracks or warping.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a 4-burner standing gas cooker with an oven and visible racks, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition. Seller working/warranty/barely-used claims are not proven by the photos, so the price should assume unverified performance and safety until the requested tests are shown.
